environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate in private subnet. MongoDB Atlas accessible via VPC peering. S3 access is routed exclusively through a Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with an endpoint policy that includes a condition restricting GetObject calls: the policy requires aws:PrincipalTag/department to match the S3 object prefix via s3:prefix condition key, AND the endpoint policy has an explicit Deny for any GetObject request where the object key prefix does not match a pre-registered set derived from the calling task's IAM session tags. The route table for the private subnet has no NAT gateway entry for S3 prefixes (pl-63a5400a), forcing all S3 traffic through the VPCE. Additionally, the ECS task role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/ReportServiceBoundary) that restricts s3:GetObject to keys matching 'reports/${aws:PrincipalTag/department}/*' only.

config.network: Private subnet, no NAT for S3 prefix list, Gateway VPCE only
config.permissions_boundary: s3:GetObject restricted to keys matching reports/${aws:PrincipalTag/department}/*
config.ecs_task_tags: department tag set at task launch from authenticated caller context
config.s3_endpoint: vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 (Gateway type, sole route for S3)
